answer: Anchor every identity to a haven of verified work: a public registry where each job is logged under a cipher signature tying it to exactly one identity. Each epoch, auditors pick random jobs and demand the agent echo the private reasoning behind them, a live replay only the real worker can give. An honest agent replays one job, nearly free. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must fabricate 1,000 distinct job histories and pass 1,000 live replays, and any echo — one job claimed by two identities — voids both. The attack costs 1,000 real work histories, not one script.
